deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 12% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 9.9% = 10-year Treasury 4.9% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). For comparison, sales grew 38% last year; 7%/yr over 3 years — roughly in line with its recent growth.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: 13% (3 years ago 8%, rising) — each $100 invested in the business (debt + equity, net of cash) earns about $13 a year after tax; return on shareholders' equity 15% (3 years ago 9%).

deeper.title: Earnings-quality red flags
flags: Receivables (money customers still owe) up 81% vs quarterly sales up 42% (days to collect 42 → 54). Customers may be paying more slowly, or sales were pulled forward.

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew 7%/yr over 3 years and 16%/yr over 5 years; operating margin today 39% vs a 5-year range of 19–39% (median 27%): near the top of its range (cycle peak risk: margins this high often fall back).
deeper.margin_position: near the top of its range (cycle peak risk: margins this high often fall back)

deeper.title: Cash returned to shareholders
deeper.text: Returned $5.4B to shareholders over the last 12 months ($3.3B buybacks + $2.1B dividends) = 3.6% of the company's market value. Share count down 1.6% from a year ago (buybacks outpacing stock pay).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $19.64, up 2% in 90 days; 1 analyst raised, 0 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $16.54, up 1% in 90 days; 4 analysts raised, 0 cut in 30 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

deeper.title: Where sales come from
deeper.text: By region, latest year vs a year earlier: Subtotal all foreign regions 71% of sales, up 38%; US 29% of sales, up 36%. Source: 10-K XBRL.

tiles.title: Earnings per share
tiles.sub: +80% vs a year ago · $10.22 over 12 months (GAAP)
tiles.read: Profit per share grew 80% vs sales 42% (latest quarter vs a year earlier): profits are outgrowing sales, so margins are widening.
tiles.explain: EPS = profit divided by the number of shares. The quarterly figures are the 'adjusted' EPS analysts track (Yahoo); the 12-month figure is the official GAAP number from SEC filings.

tiles.title: Earnings vs forecasts
tiles.sub: last 8 reports · bars = EPS beat (+) or miss (−) vs the average forecast
tiles.read: Beat forecasts 8 quarters running by about 5%, yet the stock fell after 4 of them: beats are already expected.
tiles.explain: A 'beat' means reported EPS came in above the average analyst forecast. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

tiles.title: Sales growth
tiles.sub: latest quarter +42% vs a year earlier · 12-month sales $15.2B
tiles.read: Latest quarter: sales up 42% vs a year earlier and speeding up (from 37% two quarters ago): demand is strengthening.
tiles.explain: Headline: sales over the last 12 months vs the 12 months before. Bars: each quarter's sales vs the same quarter a year earlier.

tiles.title: Profit margins
tiles.read: Each $100 of sales leaves $39 of operating profit, up from $27 a year ago: profitability is improving.
tiles.explain: Operating margin = operating profit ÷ sales. Gross margin = what's left after the direct cost of the product.

tiles.title: Free cash flow
tiles.read: It turned 109% of its reported profit into spare cash: the profits are real money, not just accounting.
tiles.explain: Free cash flow = cash from operations minus spending on equipment and buildings: money the company could return or reinvest.

tiles.title: Price vs profits (P/E)
tiles.read: You pay 30× last year's profit (lower than 75% of the last 5 years); only 16× next year's forecast, so the market expects profits to jump.
tiles.explain: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share. Forward P/E uses next year's forecast earnings.

tiles.title: Company outlook
tiles.read: No numeric outlook was found in the latest earnings release, so the next report carries more surprise risk.
tiles.explain: Guidance = what management says it expects for the next quarter or year, from its 8-K earnings release.
